description.en: Starts changing a camera's depth-of-field range over a number of frames. Depth of field: the blur of what is out of focus, set per camera (see also the DepthLevel and DepthRange settings of CMND_SET_CAMERA_PARAM). It takes two range values and a length: the talk helpers pass 1.0, 1.5 when a talk starts and 1.5, 1.0 when it ends; which of the two is the start and which the end value was not traced. Wait with CMND_IS_DEPTHRANGE_FADE.
Length of the fade in frames.

true once started, false if the camera is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 4 arguments are given.

examples.case: When a stand-up talk starts (real usage, from ie4_ev_main.nut, StartStandEvent)
At the start of a skill scene (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
